collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-28  -  THE SEA'S SMALL GIFTS SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A young gatherer discovers a rocky shore crowded with shells, living creatures, and unusual stones.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A young gatherer discovers a rocky shore crowded with shells, living creatures, and unusual stones.

choices.label: Observe the Creatures Without Collecting Them.
Teach a Younger Villager How to Recognize Occupied Shells.
Ask Whether the Village Actually Needs More Shells.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The gatherer returns with a few beautiful shells and leaves the living creatures undisturbed.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Few shells are empty, so the gatherer returns with almost nothing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The gatherer notices how several animals shelter beneath the rocks.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Rising water ends the observation early, and the gatherer retreats safely.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The younger villager learns to look carefully before picking anything up.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They disagree about one shell and decide to leave it where it lies.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The craft workers have enough materials, so the gatherer leaves the shore untouched.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A few shells are needed for repairs, and the gatherer collects only suitable empty ones.
